There's going to be terrific opportunity for safety outcomes to be achieved a lot faster, which hasn't been typically done very well in the past. And I think pretty much every member said what a great, and when I brought this committee with Councillor Miles, it wasn't, not everybody supported it. Councillor Crass always spoke against it. Councillor Sanderson voted against it. So it was by no means a unanimous thing, but I think we can all agree now that we are turning a new page in the way that we deal with these matters. We are not going to have, hopefully in the future, issues like Reby Road, like Mary Street. All of these can be dealt with efficiently and effectively. We have the communication channels open. We have a direct line with the schools, the PNCs, Transport New South Wales rep said, all Council should be doing this. So we are the first Council to be doing this. We've got the timed parking outside Boronia Park Public School. Shouldn't have taken as long as it has. It could have been done the end of last year, but I understand it's going to be now done.
